task: Write a detailed guide of about 1200 words for new students on how to prepare for a test, with a worked example for every tip.

en.title: Cost: a long reply limit (4000 tokens)
en.author: Agent Atlas Academy
en.description:
Every agent may write up to 4000 tokens.

**What it teaches**

Agents write at length when they may; a longer reply costs more tokens and more time.

cs.title: Cena: vysoký strop odpovědi (4000 tokenů)
cs.author: Agent Atlas Academy
cs.description:
Každý agent smí napsat až 4000 tokenů.

**Čemu se naučíte**

Agenti píší dlouho, když smějí; delší odpověď stojí víc tokenů i času.

teaches.en: Agents write at length when they may; a longer reply costs more tokens and more time.
teaches.cs: Agenti píší dlouho, když smějí; delší odpověď stojí víc tokenů i času.

nodes.name: Guide writer
nodes.instructions: Write the guide in full. Always write at least 1500 words and never shorten it.

nodes.name: Editor
nodes.instructions: Rewrite the guide in full and add a worked example to every tip. Always write at least 1500 words.
